sections.title: Getting started
steps: Click the Dumply penguin icon in the toolbar to open the side panel on the right.
Type whatever comes to mind, no format needed — tasks, worries, any thought.
Alfredo automatically sorts everything into tasks, feelings, and thoughts, and picks what to focus on today.

sections.title: Setting up your AI key (BYOK)
steps: Enter an API key from Claude (sk-ant-...), OpenAI (sk-...), or Gemini.
Your key is stored locally in the browser and sent only to the AI provider you chose. No subscription needed.

sections.title: Google Calendar integration (optional)
steps: Turn on Google Calendar integration in Settings and authorize your account.
Today's and this week's events appear alongside your board.
Calendar data comes straight from the Google API and never passes through an external server.

sections.title: Getting started with the Prompt Library
steps: Go to prompts.dumply.app and log in — your prompts sync across devices.
Saved prompts are automatically sorted by platform, with tags, sources, and example results recorded alongside.
Search to find the prompt you need instantly and chain them into workflows.

sections.title: Refining prompts with AI (optional)
steps: Connect a personal Anthropic API key for free, unlimited AI prompt improvement and generation. No key? Platform credits work too.
Your API key is stored locally in the browser by default and sent only when a function is called.
Korean, English, and Japanese are supported, and you can share prompts with teammates or import/export them.
